tex_content.html:
Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0099 1. Corollary 3.19\group harmonic-map-flow

For a diffeomorphism $f$ and $h=(f^{-1})^*g$, the identity map from $(\M ^n,g)$ to $(\M ^n,h)$ has harmonic map Laplacian given by the connection difference $g^{\alpha \beta }\bigl(-\Gamma (g)^\gamma _{\alpha \beta }+\Gamma (h)^\gamma _{\alpha \beta }\bigr)$.
